end.summary:
- Practised examples of diversity in festivals, clothing, food and languages.
- Identified shared threads such as seasonal celebrations, harvest, shared food and togetherness.
- Explained that different traditions can share common feelings and values.
- Discussed how communication and sharing can connect people with different languages and foods.
- Teach-back was not passed; no misconception was recorded.
end.parentNote: Riya practised comparing different regional traditions and finding shared ideas beneath them, using festivals, food, clothing and languages. They gave several relevant examples and connected celebrations with shared happiness and togetherness. Riya was unsure about whether the crops linked with Lohri, Pongal and Bihu are all rabi crops; this was not confirmed later in the lesson. At home, ask them to make a small table with one example each of regional food, dress, language and festival, plus one shared value.
